title: AI-Powered Fall Detection System
subtitle: INTELLIGENT SAFETY MONITORING
sideText: DETECT FALLS. SEND ALERTS. SUPPORT SAFETY.
description: An intelligent fall detection system designed to identify when a person falls and automatically send an email notification. The project combines automated fall detection with email alerts to demonstrate how computer vision can support safety monitoring.
impact: Implemented a fall detection workflow that identifies potential falls and triggers email notifications, combining visual analysis with automated communication.

howItWorks.title: Person Monitoring
howItWorks.description: Analyzes visual input to monitor a person and collect the information needed by the fall detection system.

howItWorks.title: Fall Detection
howItWorks.description: Processes the visual input to determine whether a person has fallen using the implemented detection logic.

howItWorks.title: Automated Email Alerts
howItWorks.description: Sends an email notification when the system detects a potential fall, helping communicate the event to the intended recipient.
